method: Visual inspection with view_image of three untouched native PNGs recaptured on finaled6e; no screenshot editing or pixel replacement. This note is not added to native assertion totals.

images.observation: Useful visible chamfered window reveals and cross muntins on the real IGN commercial envelope. Horizontal sill top is independently verified in exact published mesh vertices; image alone is not treated as a millimetric measurement.
Useful visible panelled door and a louvered pair at left on the real selected residential building; outer relief and inclined blade shading are visible.

Poorly framed view of wall and cropped higher window. Targeted low bay lies below coarse surrounding terrain; this raw image is preserved but is not claimed to show the selected louver pair. Native published-buffer geometry checks remain valid and separate.

limits: Authored metric profiles are not measured facade surveys.
The frozen source building is not repositioned to make a camera or a coarse terrain mismatch look better.
A rendered vertex-range proof does not establish visibility of a buried bay.
